features: Ascendant Bite: Bonus Action. Deals 6d6 Necrotic damage. Heals Astarion for the full amount of damage dealt. Grants 'Happy' (+1 to all rolls) to self and 'Bloodless' to target. Recharge: Once per combat.
Empowered Strikes: All melee weapon and unarmed strikes deal an additional 1d10 Necrotic damage.
Misty Escape: As a reaction when taking damage, you can transform into a misty cloud (Gaseous Form) and move up to your speed without provoking opportunity attacks.
Vampiric Resistances: Resistance to Necrotic and Poison damage. Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from non-magical attacks.
Essence of the Lord: Drinking from CR 1+ creatures grants 1 extra action next turn.
Dread Ambusher: +10ft speed and extra attack on Turn 1.
Assassinate: Advantage on those who haven't acted; auto-crit on surprised targets.
Psychic Blades: Expend Bardic Inspiration to deal 2d6 Psychic damage on a weapon hit.
Words of Terror: After speaking for 1 min, target makes WIS save or becomes Frightened of you.
Bardic Inspiration (d6): Use a bonus action to bolster an ally (2/long rest).
Sneak Attack (1d6): Deal extra damage to targets when you have advantage.
Aura of Murder: Enemies within 6ft are Vulnerable to Piercing damage (Bhaalist Armour).
Ascended Presence: You are permanently immune to sunlight, appear as a living High Elf, and possess supernatural beauty.
Vampire Lord's Authority: You have advantage on all Charisma-based checks made against other vampires or vampire spawn.
Umbral Sight: While in darkness, you are invisible to any creature that relies on darkvision to see you.
Cunning Action: Bonus action to Dash, Disengage, or Hide.
Jack of All Trades: Add half proficiency bonus to non-proficient ability checks.
Song of Rest (d6): Extra 1d6 healing for allies during a short rest.
Mantle of Whispers: When a humanoid dies within 30ft, you can capture its shadow to use as a magical disguise, gaining surface memories and +5 to Deception.
Countercharm: Use an action to start a performance that grants allies advantage on saves against being Frightened or Charmed.
Favored Enemy: Undead - Advantage on Survival checks to track and Int on lore checks.
Natural Explorer: Underdark - Doubled proficiency for related INT/WIS checks; improved travel benefits.
Iron Mind: You have gained proficiency in Wisdom saving throws.

Evasion: When you are subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, you instead take no damage if you succeed on the saving throw, and only half damage if you fail.
Sneak Attack (4d6): Your precision strikes now deal significantly more damage.

core_memories: Astarion has ascended as a Vampire Lord following the defeat of Cazador, beginning his reign with a triple-gestalt focus on stealth and shadow magic.
Astarion Ancunín reigns from the Szarr Palace with a retinue of seven spawn and twelve mortal guards led by Leon.
Astarion has finalized his Triple Gestalt as a Gloomstalker/Assassin/College of Whispers, prioritizing psychic terror and lethal ambush strikes for his new reign.
Astarion has officially begun his reign as the Ascendant Vampire Lord from the Szarr Palace, supported by Leon and Dalyria.
Astarion's first attempt to command the surviving spawn at Szarr Palace was met with silent resistance, revealing that his authority is not yet absolute.
Astarion successfully exerted his authority over the surviving spawn, beginning to break their wary resistance.
Astarion has successfully established his absolute authority over the surviving spawn at Szarr Palace through a promise of protection and prosperity.
Astarion (Lvl 1) followed Dalyria (Lvl 3) to the library and successfully deciphered a secret ledger revealing Cazador's payments to 'The Watcher' and a 'contingency shipment' at Gray Harbour.
Astarion left Szarr Palace to investigate Gray Harbour personally, ordering Leon to recruit level 5+ elite scouts while he was intercepted by Watchmen due to a failed stealth approach.
Astarion (Lvl 1) successfully navigated a Harbour Watch patrol in Gray Harbour using a social bluff, maintaining his 'Living Mask' while pursuing Cazador's secret shipment.
Astarion bribed a street urchin to create a distraction at Gray Harbour, allowing him to successfully infiltrate the back slip and locate Cazador's 'contingency shipment' unnoticed.

Astarion (Lvl 1) observed the delivery of the 'contingency shipment' at Gray Harbour; while he remained hidden, he was unable to clearly identify 'The Watcher'—a woman wearing a weeping eye amulet—before the shipment was moved onto a cutter.
Astarion tracked the Watcher's cutter through Gray Harbour to a sea-gate beneath the Counting House, but a stealth failure allowed a Grey-Cloak Scout to intercept him on the rooftops.
Astarion was intercepted on the rooftops of Gray Harbour by a Grey-Cloak Scout who serves 'The Lady' and seems prepared for his arrival.
Astarion executed a Grey-Cloak Scout on the rooftops of Gray Harbour, revealing 'The Lady's' awareness of his ascent and a connection to the Counting House.
Astarion has finalized his transition to Level 2, mastering Cunning Action and Jack of All Trades while expanding his psychic and predatory spellcasting.
Astarion looted a Grey-Cloak Scout and found orders identifying the shipment's destination as Vault 9 in the Counting House, with a midnight deadline.
Astarion returned to Szarr Palace to rendezvous with Leon and the newly recruited Level 5 Gloomstalker scouts, leaving roughly seventy-five minutes before the midnight deadline at the Counting House.
Astarion, supported by his Lvl 5 Gloomstalker scouts, successfully infiltrated the Counting House sea-gate at 23:15, bypassing magical wards through the harbor foundations.
Astarion and his Gloomstalker strike team successfully infiltrated Vault 9 through the maintenance vents, but a clumsy landing alerted 'The Watcher' to their presence.
The 'Watcher' is a high-ranking operative for 'The Weeping Eye' and was found in Vault 9 with a mysterious, vibrating sarcophagus meant for 'The Lady'.
Astarion and his elite Gloomstalker team successfully engaged 'The Watcher' in Vault 9, neutralizing one guard and wounding the other while closing in on their target.
Astarion attempted to seize the Watcher's weeping eye amulet in Vault 9 but failed, as a mysterious necrotic sarcophagus began to open.
In Vault 9, Astarion critically wounded 'The Watcher' with a psychic strike just as a mysterious, high-ranking necrotic entity began to emerge from the lead-lined sarcophagus.
In Vault 9, Astarion executed 'The Watcher' with a psychic strike, but was left near death as a legendary necrotic entity rose from the sarcophagus.
Astarion (Lvl 2) attempted to command the mysterious entity to surrender in Vault 9, but she mocked his stolen power while his scouts wounded the last guard.
Astarion executed the final Grey-Cloak guard in Vault 9 with an Ascendant Bite, regaining some vitality and triggering the Deathstalker Mantle's invisibility.
Astarion's attempt to parley with the ancient entity in Vault 9 failed utterly; she dismissed his Ascendant power as 'stolen' and prepared to strike.

Astarion attempted to pivot to a position of submission and utility when confronted by the ancient entity in Vault 9, but she remains dismissive of his 'stolen' lordship and has set a test of utility.
Astarion successfully defended the ancient entity in Vault 9 by neutralizing elite bank guards, earning a temporary reprieve and a test of utility from the legendary necrotic horror.
Astarion retrieved the Weeping Eye Amulet from the Watcher and learned that the 'midnight deadline' is a ritual window for a Shadowfell tether meant to turn the Counting House into a planar bridge.

The Silken Lady warned Astarion that the 'midnight deadline' is a Shadowfell tether activation, dismissing his ambition to steal its power as the folly of a thief who has not yet mastered his own crumbs.
Astarion offered the Weeping Eye Amulet to the Silken Lady, securing her guidance to stabilize the Shadowfell tether and proving his utility as an anchor.
At the stroke of midnight in Vault 9, Astarion successfully anchored a Shadowfell planar bridge under the Silken Lady's guidance, proving his utility as a vessel for the Weaver of Lies' tether.
At midnight in Vault 9, Astarion successfully anchored the Shadowfell bridge and neutralized the first wave of infiltrators with a lethal surprise strike.
At midnight in Vault 9, Astarion successfully executed a Shadowfell Infiltrator with a psychic strike while anchoring the planar bridge under the Silken Lady's guidance.
At midnight in Vault 9, Astarion anchored a planar bridge and neutralized the first Shadowfell waves under the Silken Lady's guidance before being confronted by a Lvl 12 Justiciar.
In Vault 9, Astarion faced a Shadowfell Justiciar (Lvl 12) while anchoring the bridge, realizing the Silken Lady expects him to handle the Weaver's champion as a test of his utility.
Astarion successfully anchored the Shadowfell planar bridge in Vault 9 and annihilated the Weaver of Lies' champion, securing the respect of the Silken Lady.
Astarion (Lvl 5) failed to siphon power from the Shadowfell rift in Vault 9, resulting in a necrotic backlash, but successfully secured 15,000gp in vault assets with his scouts.

Astarion successfully led the Silken Lady and his scouts from Vault 9 via the maintenance tunnels, but triggered a harbor security trap on the black ice, drawing the attention of Harbour Watch snipers.
Astarion decisively neutralized the Harbour Watch ambush at the sea-gate, further impressing the Silken Lady with his predatory utility during the exfiltration.
Astarion successfully exfiltrated from the Counting House with the Silken Lady, only to find the Gur hunters launching a major assault on the Szarr Palace gardens.
Astarion decisively neutralized the Gur assault on Szarr Palace gardens, executing their leader Vane and securing the Silken Lady's respect as a true master of his domain.
Astarion captured two Gur hunters during the palace garden defense and successfully interrogated them, revealing the location of their primary camp in the Lower City sewers near Heapside.
Astarion returned to Szarr Palace, neutralized the Gur assault, and discovered an internal planar focus meant to hide the estate from the Shadowfell.
Astarion led the Silken Lady to the palace's internal focus but failed to master its necrotic resonance, leaving the estate's magical shroud unstable and vulnerable.
Astarion failed to master the subterranean focus through raw blood resonance, resulting in a necrotic backlash and reinforcing the Silken Lady's skepticism of his 'stolen' lordship.
The Silken Lady has yielded the mental 'handle' of the subterranean focus to Astarion, acknowledging his utility and beginning a true, if frigid, alliance.
Astarion has successfully harmonized the subterranean focus under the Silken Lady's guidance, hiding the Szarr Palace within a stable Shadowfell shroud.
Astarion used 'Words of Terror' to break a Gur captive, revealing that the Heapside cistern is defended by thirty hunters and silver/holy-water traps.
The Silken Lady's true name is Vespera, the First-Born of the Void and an ancient Shadow-Warden who now serves as an anchor for the Weaver of Lies.
Astarion has successfully executed a 'Sewer Stranglehold' on the Gur base in Heapside, trapping thirty hunters and their leader between Leon's mercenaries and his own elite strike team.
Astarion successfully executed a lethal 'Sewer Stranglehold' on the Gur cistern, annihilating their leader Gandrel's brother with a psychic ambush and trapping the survivors in a flooded kill-box.

Astarion and his elite scouts utilized the rafters of the Heapside cistern to unleash a one-sided slaughter upon the trapped Gur hunters, effectively turning their sanctuary into a crimson-flooded tomb.
Astarion decisively destroyed the Gur home base in the Heapside sewers, executing Gandrel's brother and capturing twenty survivors to secure his reign in the Upper City.
Astarion has finalized his transition to Level 6, mastering the Mantle of Whispers and refining his expertise in Insight and Investigation to solidify his lordship over the city's secrets.
Astarion has established the Shadow Bastion in the Heapside Sewers and ascended to Level 6, mastering the flaying of shadows via the Mantle of Whispers.

Astarion used a deep psychic dive into Gandrel's brother's shadow to uncover Ulma's tactical vulnerability: her dependence on an ancestral silver locket that wards her from psychic influence, and the coordinates of a weapon cache beneath the Rivington mill floorboards.
Astarion successfully raided the Rivington Mill, using flayed memories to secure a cache of Sun-Steel bolts and a Shadow-Bane scroll while the Gur were distracted by a mourning vigil.
Astarion utilized his full Shadow Vanguard (13 elite Gloomstalkers) to decisively ambush and annihilate 'The Iron Tithe' bounty hunter squad near the Szarr Palace.

Astarion used the Mantle of Whispers on the Iron Tithe leader to discover he has been designated 'Planar Threat Sigma' by the Steel Watch and is being hunted by High Inquisitor Malakor of the Counting House.
Astarion successfully executed the Locket Heist in Rivington, stealing Elder Ulma's ancestral silver ward and leaving her tactically vulnerable to his psychic influence.
Astarion has successfully neutralized Elder Ulma's tactical advantage by stealing her silver locket, leaving the Gur leadership vulnerable to psychic manipulation.
Astarion returned to Szarr Palace and began orchestrating a plan to frame the Zhentarim for the Shadowfell rift to divert the 'Planar Threat Sigma' investigation.
Astarion convened his council to plan a counter-intelligence operation against High Inquisitor Malakor, proposing to frame the Zhentarim for the Shadowfell rift.
Astarion's scouts identified the Zhentarim 'Black Adder' warehouse as a frame-target, but were spotted by a shadow-mage, putting the Black Network on high alert.
Astarion attempted to frame Lord Hhune for the planar rift but discovered that High Inquisitor Malakor has deployed high-sensitivity arcane sensors that can detect his specific necrotic resonance.

Astarion successfully framed House Hhune by planting necrotic leaks in the surrounding sewers, leading the Steel Watch sensors to triangulate the patriarchar's estate as the source of the Shadowfell resonance.
Astarion has successfully subjugated Elder Ulma and the Rivington Gur, transforming the tribe into a broken labor and spy network for the Shadow Vanguard.
Astarion has established the Rivington Cell at the Mill, organizing the 30 broken Gur hunters into specialized tracking units under Leon's command.

Astarion successfully executed a synergistic strike, using a Gur-led 'Static Storm' to frame House Hhune while he infiltrated the Watchful Order's Hall of Records to access the 'Planar Threat Sigma' files.

Astarion successfully raided the Zhentarim 'Black Adder' warehouse using a stolen sensor map, securing 2,500gp in trade bars, though the specific planar contraband he sought had already been relocated.
Astarion successfully framed House Hhune for the Shadowfell rift and consolidated his Shadow Vanguard (80 total forces) across Szarr Palace, the Heapside Bastion, and the Rivington Cell.
Astarion learned from Vespera that the Vault 9 rift functions as a Sanguine Crucible capable of creating more Ascendant-tier vampires at the cost of mortal life-force.
Vespera revealed that the Vault 9 rift can be re-anchored to Szarr Palace at the cost of a permanent vitality tithe or the sacrifice of a surrogate who has 'truly lived' (Level 10+).
Astarion has identified three primary Patriar marriage candidates—Marcella Oberon, Beatrix Gneiss, and Cassia Silmerhelve—to secure political legitimacy and leverage over the Counting House.

Astarion (Lvl 6) successfully attended Lady Marcella Oberon's security briefing at the High Hall, leveraging the vacuum left by the Hhune scandal to position himself as a potential security consultant for House Oberon.
Astarion (Lvl 6) initiated a strategic alliance with Lady Marcella Oberon (Lvl 4), leveraging her fear of Malakor’s 'Sigma' purge and her family’s Ironhand supply ties to secure a political foothold.
Lady Marcella Oberon of House Oberon has invited Astarion to a private audience to discuss a 'security consultancy' for her family's Ironhand supply lines.
Astarion secured a 'Quality Partnership' with Lady Marcella Oberon, investing 10,000gp to infuse the Ironhand foundries' ore with Shadowfell static for eventual Steel Watch override.

Astarion has targeted Lady Beatrix Gneiss, the wealthy mining magnate of the Counting House mint, but his initial attempt to secure a private audience at the High Shield Club was blocked by her social circle.
Astarion successfully leveraged his 'Quality Partnership' with House Oberon to pierce Lady Beatrix Gneiss's social circle, securing a private audience just as a Zhentarim fixer arrived to hunt him.

Astarion attempted to secure a 'Mint Alliance' with Lady Beatrix Gneiss, but a diplomatic fumble and his supernatural insight revealed she is already a Zhentarim asset, just as a Black Network fixer arrived at the High Shield Club.

Astarion utilized his full Shadow Vanguard (13 elite Gloomstalkers) to decisively counter-ambush and annihilate the Zhentarim Fixer (Lvl 10) outside the High Shield Club, unmasking Lady Beatrix as a Zhentarim asset.
Astarion has reached the seventh circle of power, mastering 'Iron Mind' and 'Evasion' to fortify his mind and body against the escalating threats of the city.

Astarion successfully coerced Lady Beatrix Gneiss after executing her Zhentarim Fixer, forcing her to reveal the Black Network's safehouses: the Weeping Willow tannery and the Blushing Mermaid cellars.
Astarion successfully coerced Lady Beatrix Gneiss into a 'Protection Contract,' securing a daily tithe of 300gp from her mining interests and unmasking her as a Zhentarim asset.
Astarion successfully raided the Zhentarim counting-room beneath 'The Blushing Mermaid', rescuing Beatrix Gneiss's son and securing ledgers that map the Black Network's Shadowfell supply chain.
Astarion rescued Lucius Gneiss and extracted intelligence regarding 'The Auditor' and the 'Gilded Gallows' Zhentarim hub.
Astarion finalized a 'Protection Contract' with Lady Beatrix Gneiss after rescuing her son Lucius, securing a daily tithe and neutralizing the Zhentarim's influence over the city's minting supplies.
Astarion successfully calmed Lady Beatrix Gneiss after the rescue of her son, stabilizing the House Gneiss alliance through masterful persuasion.

The Zhentarim are facilitating the arrival of 'The Auditor', a Shadowfell mage intended to finalize the 'Shadow-Stitch'—a planar rift woven into Baldur's Gate's economic debt—centered at the Gilded Gallows in the Outer City.
The Zhentarim are facilitating the arrival of 'The Auditor', a Silver Spire tithe-collector intended to finalize the 'Shadow-Stitch' at the Gilded Gallows in the Outer City.

The Gilded Gallows is a Zhentarim riverfront warehouse in the Outer City where the Auditor is weaving a 'Shadow-Stitch'; Vespera revealed that Echo-Feeding siphons potential from the powerful and mentioned 'Sovereign Shards' as Spire artifacts needed to control the rift.
Correction: Cazador Szarr was historically Level 12, and all legacy character levels are synchronized to Baldur's Gate 3 canonical standards.
Astarion (Lvl 7) convened his council to address the 'Shadow-Stitch' threat at the Gilded Gallows and the search for 'Sovereign Shards' within the palace vaults.
Astarion raided the Gilded Gallows and critically wounded The Auditor, breaking the Zhentarim's planar hub in the Outer City but triggering a city-wide necrotic alert.

I am now level 1 again but I am a gestalt gloomstalker / assassin / one more class and suggest another good vampirish class to mix in with unique mechanics. lets assume I am still getting accustomed to new powers. This hsould be directly after bg3 and assume i have some vampire staff/servants/soldiers but a handful because most of them died in the battle.

planning_block.thinking: The Auditor is critically wounded but still conscious. The 'Shadow-Stitch' is active and unstable—assassinating her now might collapse the rift prematurely, but seizing the ledgers is the priority. Vaxen Shadow-Blade is likely nearby, and the warehouse is becoming a beacon for Malakor's diviners.

background_events.discovery_condition: Interrogation intel or scouting.
background_events.outcome: The tribe is centralized and distracted, but also highly emotional.
background_events.action: Organizing a 24-hour mourning vigil for the fallen cistern hunters.
background_events.player_impact: Provides a window for the 'Locket Heist'.

background_events.discovery_condition: Astarion encounters a Steel Watcher Diviner.
background_events.action: The disappearance of the Iron Tithe squad has triggered a higher-priority arcane tracking mission.
Ulma is petitioning the Watchful Order for a 'spectral purge' of the Upper City north ward.

background_events.discovery_condition: Astarion uses Mantle of Whispers on a Counting House official.
background_events.action: Issued a formal 'Spectral Purge' mandate for the Upper City North Ward.
background_events.player_impact: Social interaction in the Upper City is now high-risk.
background_events.outcome: Steel Watchers are now authorized to stop and scan any individual for planar resonance.
Astarion now has a secure tracking network at the northern gate of Baldur's Gate.
background_events.action: Established a secondary Shadow Bastion at the Rivington Mill.
background_events.player_impact: Acquisition of 30 specialized scout units and a second base.

background_events.discovery_condition: Leon's report and broadsheets.
background_events.outcome: The Steel Watch has arrested Lord Hhune and is excavating his cellar for 'Sigma' artifacts.
background_events.action: Initiated a full military blockade and 'spectral purge' of the Hhune estate.

background_events.discovery_condition: Mantle of Whispers on a Zhentarim agent.
background_events.outcome: They are looking for the 'Shadow Thief' who stole their trade-platinum.
background_events.action: Launched an internal investigation into the 'Black Adder' heist and the source of the Hhune frame-up.

background_events.discovery_condition: Dalyria's report.
background_events.action: Discovered 'Zhentarim' artifacts in the Hhune cellar, confirming Astarion's frame-job.
background_events.outcome: Lord Hhune is officially charged with high treason; Watchful Order focus shifts to Zhentarim hubs.

background_events.discovery_condition: Astarion intercepts an assassin or uses Mantle of Whispers.
background_events.action: Authorized a 'Termination Order' for the 'Shadow Thief' who raided the Black Adder warehouse.
background_events.outcome: Elite Zhentarim assassins are now tracking Astarion's movements.

background_events.discovery_condition: Astarion's scouts detect a tail or a confrontation occurs.
background_events.action: Arrived in the Lower City to investigate the 'Shadow Thief' of Vault 9.
background_events.player_impact: High-tier combat threat to Astarion and his operatives.
background_events.outcome: A Lvl 10 Assassin is now tracking Astarion's network.
Anyone with planar or necrotic resonance is being flagged for detention.
background_events.action: Implementing 'Soul-Scanning' checkpoints throughout the Upper City North Ward.
background_events.player_impact: Movement in the Upper City is now extremely dangerous for Astarion and Vespera.

background_events.discovery_condition: Astarion intercepts the fixer or receives a scout report.
background_events.outcome: Active pursuit of Astarion's network has begun.
background_events.action: Deploys 'The Fixer', a high-tier shadow-operative, to reclaim the stolen platinum and identify the 'Shadow Thief'.

background_events.discovery_condition: Astarion's scouts observe the chimney smoke or he infiltrates.
background_events.outcome: Intelligence at this location is becoming stale; quick action is required.
background_events.action: Zhentarim 'Snake-handlers' at the Blushing Mermaid have noticed the Fixer's silence and are burning sensitive ledgers.
background_events.player_impact: Loss of potential intelligence if delayed.

background_events.discovery_condition: Direct report to Astarion.
background_events.outcome: Tracking the courier could lead to more safehouses.
background_events.action: Shadow Vanguard scouts have identified a Zhentarim courier leaving House Gneiss's foundries with a 'priority' shipment.

background_events.discovery_condition: Astarion investigates the Gilded Gallows.
background_events.action: Begins the final approach to Baldur's Gate via the Shadowfell tether.
background_events.outcome: Planar static in the city increases.

background_events.discovery_condition: Leon's scouts report active pursuit.
background_events.action: Triangulated the Shadow Vanguard's retreat from the High Shield Club.
background_events.outcome: Assassins are closing in on the Szarr Palace perimeter.

background_events.discovery_condition: Astarion observes increased patrols or hears reports.
background_events.outcome: The Steel Watch is narrowing the search area for 'Planar Threat Sigma' to the vicinity of Szarr Palace.
background_events.action: Redirecting mobile 'Soul-Scanning' units to the North Ward following a high-resonance ping.

background_events.discovery_condition: Leon's scouts report active pursuit.
background_events.outcome: Zhentarim assassins are preparing for an infiltration or assassination attempt.
background_events.action: Probing the Szarr Palace garden walls for weaknesses in the Shadowfell shroud.

background_events.discovery_condition: Astarion investigates the Gilded Gallows or hears rumors.
background_events.outcome: A localized cold snap and necrotic silence have descended upon the Gilded Gallows district.
background_events.action: Emerged from the Shadowfell tether at a hidden location in the Outer City.

background_events.discovery_condition: Astarion's scouts detect a high-tier assassin resonance.
background_events.action: Moving toward the Gilded Gallows to intercept the 'Shadow Thief'.
background_events.outcome: Imminent high-tier combat encounter.

background_events.discovery_condition: Astarion hears the approaching heavy clanking.
background_events.action: His diviners have logged the necrotic 'flash' from the Auditor's wounding.
background_events.outcome: Steel Watchers are being dispatched to the Outer City riverfront.

rumors.content: A new 'Lord Ancunín' has recently made a massive deposit at the Counting House, sparking curiosity among the city's elite.
Dockworkers at Gray Harbour whisper that the 'Watcher's' influence is growing, with gold flowing into the pockets of Harbour Watch captains.
The Guild is agitated; someone has been moving 'lead-lined' cargo through the sea-gates without paying the usual tolls.
A high-ranking patriarchar was seen descending into the Lower City with a pair of 'shadows' at his back, sparking rumors of a secret alliance.
A high-ranking official at the Counting House was seen being escorted out in chains; rumors of a massive vault breach are spreading through the Lower City.
A high-security vault in the Counting House has gone silent; the clerks are terrified of what might have been released.
The stones of the Lower City are vibrating with a low, rhythmic hum that is driving the harbor dogs into a frenzy.
The Counting House has been locked down from the inside; the Steel Watch is standing ready on the surface.
Beggars in the Lower City speak of a woman in tattered silks who walks through walls of ice near the docks.
The harbor water has frozen solid in minutes, trapping several merchant cogs in the ice.
A spectral scream was heard from the Counting House vaults, vibrating through the bedrock of the Lower City.
A high-security vault breach has triggered an automatic surface lockdown; the Watch is warning citizens to avoid the Gray Harbour district.
Spectral figures have been seen emerging from the harbor water, which is rapidly turning to black ice.
The 'Vampire Lord' of the Upper City has abandoned his post, leaving his palace to the Gur hunters.
The Counting House is offering a 50,000 gold bounty for the head of the 'Shadow Thief' who breached Vault 9.
A 'Frozen Folly' has trapped the harbor, and some say it's the breath of an ancient winter god returned to the city.
The Steel Watch is requisitioning high-sensitivity arcane sensors from the High Hall, claiming a 'planar hazard' exists in the harbor.
Sewer-dwellers in Heapside say the rats are fleeing the old cisterns as if a great predator has moved in.
A 'Black Frost' is spreading from the Szarr Palace, wilting the gardens of the nearby patriarchars.
The High Hall is considering a tax audit on the Ancunín estate following the Counting House breach.
They say the harbor froze over in a single minute, and the snipers' throats weren't just cut—they were shattered.
Szarr Palace has vanished. You can walk right past the gates and see nothing but a wall of grey mist.
A group called 'The Iron Tithe' is paying top copper for anyone who can point out a nobleman who 'moves like a ghost'.
The Rivington Gur are lighting more fires than usual; they say a great sadness has hit the tribe.
The 'Shadow of Vault 9' is said to have an army of ghosts protecting his palace.
The High Inquisitor has a 'Black List' of patriarchars suspected of dealing with the Weaver of Lies.
A merchant in Heapside saw a Steel Watcher's eyes turn violet and melt a beggar who smelled of the void.
The Steel Watch is scouring the Upper City for a 'Planar Threat' designated Sigma.
Gur hunters have vanished from Rivington; some say the Szarr curse has reached the cliffs.
They say Lord Hhune was smuggling Shadowfell horrors into the city for the Black Network.
The Steel Watch sensors in the North Ward are so sensitive they can hear a man's sins.
The High Inquisitor has proof that the 'Sigma' threat is a Zhentarim experiment gone wrong.
House Oberon is seeking a new head of security following the 'Hhune breach'.
They say the Hhune cellar was filled with Githyanki silver, and Malakor is looking for the dragon they rode in on.
A shadow-demon has been seen stalking the rooftops near the Palace; the pets of the North Ward haven't stopped howling for three nights.
The High Inquisitor has found proof that House Hhune was the primary hub for the 'Sigma' rifts; the North Ward is breathing a collective, terrified sigh of relief.
A 'Vampire Lord' has been seen in the High Shield Club, though his skin is warm and his smile is entirely too perfect for a corpse.
The High Shield Club's brandy is tasting like iron lately—some say the vents are drawing air from a slaughterhouse.
The Zhentarim are pulling their 'shadow-mages' from the docks; rumors say a greater predator has entered the harbor.
A 'Black Frost' is spreading through the Outer City, wilting crops in a single night.
The 'Black Frost' is spreading to the Outer City, bringing a silence that stops hearts.

iron_tithe_search.changes_this_turn: Bounty hunters have established a checkpoint at the Heapside gate.
iron_tithe_search.new_consequences: Escape from the sewers will require Stealth or Deception.

midnight_deadline.changes_this_turn: Astarion has taken control of the key and is anchoring the bridge under the Silken Lady's guidance.
midnight_deadline.new_consequences: Arrival of Shadowfell forces is imminent.
